messages:
Lina (Partnerships): Quick sync 1: were running a combined ISV + marketplace readiness sprint. Need to validate LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters, GatewayX + FlowBridge connectors, and listing metadata for cloud marketplaces. Low friction: small smoke suite + one joint demo recording. Who can take infra and who owns the marketplace listing fields?
Jun (Eng-Platform): I can take infra. Will provision a 1-node staging cluster, set up ingress for gateway tests, and add a marketplace metadata validator that checks icons, descriptions, and required entitlements.
Omar (Eng-ML): I'll own adapter validation for model behavior: test prompt/response parity across fp16/int8, embedding shape stability (for LlamaIndex), and streaming correctness for LangChain flows.
Becky (Marketing): For the listing we need: short tagline (<=80 chars), 3 bullets of value props, approved logo svg, and a 30s demo clip. Also legal needs a one-line partner quote. Deadline for assets?
Lina (Partnerships): Aim: assets by 2026-05-15. Technical deliverables by 2026-05-22. Demo clip ready by 2026-05-28.
Jun (Eng-Platform): Small example smoke command (to run against staging gateways):
```bash
# verify adapter roundtrip + streaming start
curl -s -N -X POST https://staging.gatewayx.redwood/v1/streams \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"adapter":"langchain","input":"Summarize: Redwood mission"}' | head -n 1
```
Expect: 200 then first chunk within 250ms.
Omar (Eng-ML): Add a tokenizer check: include a tiny payload that reproduces tokenization mismatch often seen on small hardware. Example: "Ångström unit conversion" should token count match across partners. Also verify embedding dim and dtype.
CI-Bot: [system] marketplace-metadata-lint triggered for pr #412. Results: warnings (missing svg alt text), failures (no tagline).
Becky (Marketing): I'll fix the tagline + SVG alt. Lina, can you ask partners for approved quote by EOD? We should avoid any marketing language about "enterprise-grade" without legal approval.
Lina (Partnerships): On it. Partner legal reminded. Also note: some hardware partners require we list supported GPU families (A100, H100, L4). Jun, can the marketplace validator accept a freeform "hardware_compat" field?
Jun (Eng-Platform): Yes, we'll accept a csv-like string and validate against allowed set. We'll also surface a warning for unsupported HW claims.
Omar (Eng-ML): On the adapter side, two tricky items: (1) chunking drift when LlamaIndex reconstructs documents after quantized index export, and (2) prompt templating differences in LangChain wrappers. I'll write minimal repro tests.
Becky (Marketing): Demo plan: 60s problem statement, 90s joint live demo of gateway routing + adapter fallback, 30s closing. Partners ok with pre-recorded fallback if live fails?
Lina (Partnerships): Partners prefer live but accept pre-recorded fallback. We'll set a 24h blackout on public social posts before the live demo.
Jun (Eng-Platform): Ops note: I'll create per-partner ephemeral API keys (ttl 48h) for the dry-run. Keys will be logged and revoked after demo. Also enabling per-route throttling to protect staging cluster.
Omar (Eng-ML): Perf tests: capture p50/p95/p99 for token latency, and run a 3-minute ramp to expose KV cache pressure. Tag runs with adapter+hw combo.
CI-Bot: [system] perf-job started: job-id=perf-2463001, expected duration=10m.
Becky (Marketing): Supplier docs: please include a short 2-sentence integration note we can embed in the marketplace listing so customers know what the adapter does.
Lina (Partnerships): Action items: Jun infra + validator, Omar adapter tests + perf scenarios, Becky listing copy + assets, partners: approved quote + demo attendee list. Check-in Friday 11:00 PT. :calendar:
Jun (Eng-Platform): Noted. I'll push the validator and a sample manifest schema to the shared repo.
Omar (Eng-ML): I'll open the test repo and link the tokenization repro. Quick heads-up: ask partners to include tokenizer version & model config in their adapter manifest.
Lina (Partnerships): Great. If anyone hits blockers ping me or drop notes in #partnerships. Thanks! :handshake:
